name: Sandsjöbacka - Kungsbacka C
description: Sandsjöbacka to Kungsbacka C. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
notes: Hallandsleden reports blue/medium; Naturkartan search-index text reports green/easy. Use Hallandsleden official difficulty.
Hallandsleden overview uses 69 km for Sandsjöbacka-Frillesås; Visit Kungsbacka says 62 km through Kungsbacka. This is a route-scope/measurement issue and does not change K1's official 8.7 km.
The official API geo_json is complete and matches the GPX, but API line.geometry is absent. Use GPX/API geo_json only.
Search index still contains an exact K1 Naturkartan page, but direct fetch returned 404 and no geometry could be verified. Treat as stale until a live replacement is found.

The coordinate 57.52949554,12.04073534 aligns with Grönabur/Sandsjöbacka start parking. The transit/access lane also mentioned Högsered p-plats/Närtrafik, but Länsstyrelsen's Högsered Närtrafik note appears to refer to another Sandsjöbacka reserve access point. Do not label the K1 start parking as Högsered without verification.

Länsstyrelsen describes Sandsjöbacka as part of Natura 2000, but the rules lane did not verify a direct K1 GPX/Natura intersection. Import reserve start span; keep Natura as nearby/broader context unless GIS resolves direct overlap.
